biggest_catch: The base $25 requires only a $25 savings deposit, but the extra $75 needs the friend to open an Enjoy! Rewards Checking account with eStatements and a $250+ recurring direct deposit within 90 days - two very different hurdles.
catches: Referrer: Southland member; get a personalized link from the Southland Digital Banking app and share it.
$25 bonus: referred new member opens a Primary Savings account with a $25 minimum deposit.
Extra $75 bonus: friend also opens an Enjoy! Rewards Checking account, enrolls in eStatements, and establishes a recurring direct deposit of at least $250 within the first 90 days.
Both referrer and friend get rewarded; bonuses automatically deposited into accounts.
No referral-count cap stated on the page; no expiry stated.

steps: Log in to the Southland Digital Banking app and click 'Refer a Friend' to get your personalized link.
Friend applies via the link and opens a Primary Savings account with a $25 minimum deposit.
You get $25 per referral - $100 if the friend also opens Enjoy! Rewards Checking with eStatements and a $250+ recurring direct deposit within 90 days.
timing: Bonuses automatically deposited once the friend's application is accepted and qualifications are met.
